About me

I’m a fresh Information Technology graduate who loves networks and penetration testing. My goal is to protect systems and keep digital life secure.

During my co-op at the Tabuk Region Municipality I prepared 16 reports aligned with NCA cybersecurity controls. I use UX/UI skills to make my technical projects clearer and easier to use, and I also bring public speaking and podcasting experience.

My graduation project, TruckScope, detects heavy trucks from satellite imagery with YOLOv8. I’ve also won first place in a Metaverse competition and third place in a networking camp.

03 / Projects

Selected work

NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 · Web + AI

Lunar Landing Site Navigator

Machine LearningLogistic Regressionscikit-learnNASA LRO/LOLAJPL HorizonsWeb App

An interactive web app for exploring candidate lunar landing sites. Click any point on a NASA LRO/LOLA relief map or a mission marker and get elevation, slope, Sun position, illumination, shadow, temperature, Earth communication and dust level, with Sun position driven by JPL Horizons data.

AI / ML INSIDE

The heart of the project is a heritage-similarity model: it learns what the 11 past soft-landing sites look like and scores every 1° cell of the Moon by how closely it resembles them.

NASA LOLA terrain→4 features→Logistic regression→Leave-one-site-out test→0–100 similarity score
64,800lunar cells scored
11past landings as labels
0.76AUC (leave-one-site-out)
76.3mean held-out percentile

The ML Lab explains every score feature by feature (surface slope, Earth line-of-sight, latitude, elevation). The model card is honest about limits: only 11 examples, so it fails on the far side and the poles, and it ranks similarity, not safety or mission success.

Built as a web app with a Python backend, an interactive ML Lab and NASA open data end to end.

Graduation Capstone · Team of 3

TruckScope: AI/GIS Vehicle Tracking

YOLOv8LaravelMySQLLeaflet.jsComputer Vision

A platform that uses satellite imagery and YOLOv8 to spot heavy trucks bypassing main roads and entering residential areas. The user picks an area, marks 4 points around it and runs detection; trucks are found and counted instantly.

Satellite imagery→YOLOv8→Laravel + MySQL→Leaflet.js map
Impact: prevents accidents near schools and neighborhoods, cuts road repair costs, and gives 24/7 automated oversight.
